summary: Tested the Live Leaderboard feature end to end. Backend: 11 of 11 pytest tests pass: public GET sorted with tied ranks, 401 without/with wrong X-Organiser-Key on all write endpoints plus verify, add/409 duplicate (case-insensitive), validation, bulk add (dupes skipped, invalid rows reported), delta/set with the 0 floor, 404s and delete. Frontend: the passcode gate (wrong code shows a toast, the right code unlocks), add one, bulk paste with toasts, +50/+10/-10 buttons, set exact score, remove with confirm and lock all work. The public /leaderboard page picked up an organiser score change in about 5s without a reload. Search hides the podium and filters rows. The home #leaderboard nav link scrolls correctly. No horizontal overflow at 390px (/leaderboard, /organiser) or 1024px (navbar). One real UI bug: text in podium cards overlaps at sm+ widths.

minor.issue: A header row copied from Google Sheets (e.g. 'Name<TAB>College' or 'Full Name<TAB>College Name') passes validation and gets added as a participant. Consider skipping a first row whose name matches common header words.

The rate limiter keys on the first X-Forwarded-For value, which the client can spoof. An attacker can rotate that header to get around the 10-failure lockout. Use the last trusted proxy hop or request.client instead.
The name tiebreak sort is case-sensitive (Mongo binary collation), so 'aman' sorts after 'Zoya'. updated_at also ignores deletions. Low impact.

ui_bugs.issue:
At sm+ widths (seen at 1024 and 1920) podium cards have fixed heights (sm:h-44/h-36/h-32: measured 174/142/126px). The content needs about 156px. Because of flex-col justify-end, the name and college

elements shrink, so the name overlaps the college line. Rank-3 card name is unreadable (strikethrough look); rank-2 name overlaps 'IEM'. Fix: use sm:min-h-44/36/32 instead of sm:h-*, or add shrink-0 to the children.

issues: No overflow, but the logo wraps to two lines ('DataVerse' / '2K27') and the Register button sits about 6px from the right edge, which feels cramped. Consider smaller nav gaps at the lg breakpoint.

When several people share a rank (e.g. everyone at 0), the podium still shows silver/bronze styling for two cards that both say 'Rank 2'. Consider hiding the podium until the top scores are greater than 0.

s)
Optional: skip a Google Sheet header row in bulk paste
Optional: harden the rate limiter IP source against a spoofed X-Forwarded-For
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: require_organiser trusts the client-supplied first X-Forwarded-For entry, so the brute-force limiter can be bypassed
Organiser.jsx: only 401 auto-locks; 429 (rate limited) just shows a toast, which is acceptable
ScoreManager set input: a decimal like 1.5 gives a 422 toast from the backend, which is acceptable; could use step=1
